formal_statement: ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (L : Submodule ℂ (Fin n × Fin n → ℂ)), (∀ t ∈ L, MvPolynomial.eval (fun p => 1 + t p) (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ n) = (Nat.factorial n : ℂ)) → Module.finrank ℂ L ≤ C * n
plain_statement: There is a constant C such that every linear space L of n x n complex matrices on which perm(J_n + t) = n! for all t in L has dim L <= C n. With the checked L-gct-077 it gives border dc(perm_m) >= m^2 - (C + 2) m + O(1), past the checked 2/3. Floor checked: L-gct-080 (2n - 3). The determinant analogue at I is quadratic (nilpotent spaces), so a proof must use what perm lacks.
title: TARGET: level spaces of the permanent at J are linear: dim L <= C n whenever perm(J_n + t) = n! on L
